proposed_comments.title: Append sent and received together (2/4)
proposed_comments.body:
### Append sent and received together (2/4)

**Severity:** `medium`

These counters are captured from the same network sample. Route both updates through the paired operation so a reader cannot observe the halfway state between the two appends.

```suggestion
        history.Add(usage.Sent, usage.Received);
```

confidence.rationale: Pinned caller and lock evidence supports a transient mismatch between the paired chart series: each list remains individually locked, but the append and snapshot pairs are not atomic. proposed_comments.title: Read both series from one snapshot (3/4)
proposed_comments.body:
### Read both series from one snapshot (3/4)

**Severity:** `medium`

The histories are snapshotted separately, so a sample can arrive between these calls and leave the chart arrays at different update boundaries. Read both arrays from one paired snapshot.

```suggestion
            var (sent, received) = history.Snapshot();
```
